headline: Roku’s OLED TVs are up to $400 off during Prime Day, starting at $700
summary: Roku's new OLED TVs are on sale, with discounts up to $400. The 55-inch Pro Series OLED starts at $699.99 for Prime Day. This deal is a return of an earlier promotion, coinciding with October Prime Day.

headline: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
summary: OpenAI is rolling out a new 'Intelligent UI' update for ChatGPT. This feature allows ChatGPT to include interactive visuals like diagrams, charts, and buttons. The update launches alongside GPT-6, enhancing user interaction.

headline: The first Nvidia RTX Spark laptops cost up to $7,000
summary: Laptops featuring Nvidia's new RTX Spark chip are now available. These high-end devices are priced to compete with MacBook Pros, reaching up to $7,000. Configurations from major brands start around $2,599 for an 18-core model.

headline: It appears .agent and .agi are about to be the hot new domains
summary: ICANN is accepting applications for new top-level domains for the first time in years. New suffixes like .agent and .agi are expected to become popular. 1,615 applications have been announced for these new internet domains.

headline: Some of Our Favorite Switch 2 Controllers Are Dropping to Actually Reasonable Prices for October Prime Day
summary: Popular Nintendo Switch 2 controllers are seeing significant price drops. These deals are available during October Prime Day. The article highlights favorite controllers now at reasonable prices.

headline: Gears of War E-Day is a 'Natural Choice to Be an Exclusive' – Studio Head Mike Crump Claims Series Carries The Banner For Xbox
summary: Gears of War: E-Day recently launched as an Xbox exclusive. Studio Head Mike Crump states its exclusivity is a 'natural choice.' Crump believes the series proudly represents the Xbox brand.

headline: TOEM 2 Review
summary: TOEM 2 is reviewed, acknowledging some lost novelty from its predecessor. Despite this, the sequel is praised for its quality on its own merits. The review suggests it's still a great game for fans.

headline: Save 50% Off the Massive 98" TCL QM8L 4K TV With Super Quantum Dot Technology During Prime Day
summary: The massive 98-inch TCL QM8L 4K TV is on sale for 50% off. This deal features Super Quantum Dot Technology. During Prime Day, it's considered a better option than OLED at this size.

headline: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
summary: Tory leader Kemi Badenoch announced plans to abolish inheritance tax on family homes. She aims to convince voters the party has changed post-2024 election defeat. Badenoch stated the Conservative party is 'coming back.'

headline: Chris Mason: Tories united behind Badenoch - but party still needs to win over voters
summary: Chris Mason reports that Kemi Badenoch has strong party support. Despite internal unity, the Tories lag behind Labour and Reform in polls. The party faces the challenge of winning over the general electorate.

headline: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
summary: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, has died, according to her union. Her forced eviction in September sparked widespread national protests. She was removed from her home of over 70 years on a stretcher.

headline: Boots sold in £7bn deal to Canadian billionaire family
summary: High Street pharmacy chain Boots has been sold for £7 billion. The buyer is a Canadian billionaire family. The sale was officially announced on Wednesday.
